title: Aymo AI: All-in-one AI Platform for Teams | Product Hunt
excerpt: Get access to latest models of GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, Kimi, GLM and 45+ top AI models in one secure workspace with powerful team features. Compare outputs AI model response side by side, upload and chat with files, search the web, generate images, and collaborate with your team on every plan. Free and decent plans that can replace a dozen AI tools: Bundled with a Chrome extension, apps, useful AI tools, and AI Docs on the way.
